    const int upperRank = worldRank + 1 == worldSize ? MPI_PROC_NULL : worldRank + 1;
    const size_t chunkCount = (planeElements + static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX) - 1) /
                              static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX);
    std::vector<MPI_Request> requests;
    requests.reserve(4 * chunkCount);

    Real* input = deviceGrid1;
    Real* output = deviceGrid2;

    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
    if (worldRank == 0) {
        std::printf("Running stencil computation...\n");
    }
    const double start = MPI_Wtime();

    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < iterations; ++iteration) {
        // These edge planes are produced on boundaryStream.  The middle from the
        // preceding iteration may still finish while halo transfer is initiated.
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(boundaryStream));

        Real* receiveLower = input;
        Real* receiveUpper = input + (localSlab.planes + 1) * planeElements;
        const Real* sendLower = input + planeElements;
        const Real* sendUpper = input + localSlab.planes * planeElements;

        if (!cudaAwareMpi) {
            if (lowerRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(sendLowerHost, sendLower, planeBytes,
                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, transferStream));
            }
            if (upperRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(sendUpperHost, sendUpper, planeBytes,
                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, transferStream));
            }
            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(transferStream));
            receiveLower = receiveLowerHost;
            receiveUpper = receiveUpperHost;
            sendLower = sendLowerHost;
            sendUpper = sendUpperHost;
        }

        postHaloExchange(requests, receiveLower, receiveUpper, sendLower, sendUpper,
                         planeElements, lowerRank, upperRank);

        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(interiorStream));
        if (localSlab.planes > 2) {
            launchStencilRange(input, output, nx, ny, nz, localSlab.globalZBegin,
                               2, localSlab.planes - 1, interiorStream);
        }

        waitForRequests(requests);

        if (!cudaAwareMpi) {
            if (lowerRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(input, receiveLowerHost, planeBytes,
                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, boundaryStream));
            }
            if (upperRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(
                    input + (localSlab.planes + 1) * planeElements,
                    receiveUpperHost, planeBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
                    boundaryStream));
            }
        }

        const bool firstPlaneIsInterior = localSlab.globalZBegin != 0;
        const bool lastPlaneIsInterior =
            localSlab.globalZBegin + localSlab.planes != nz;
        if (localSlab.planes <= 2) {
            const size_t first = firstPlaneIsInterior ? 1 : 2;
            const size_t last = lastPlaneIsInterior
                                    ? localSlab.planes
                                    : localSlab.planes - 1;
            launchStencilRange(input, output, nx, ny, nz, localSlab.globalZBegin,
                               first, last, boundaryStream);
        } else {
            if (firstPlaneIsInterior) {
                launchStencilRange(input, output, nx, ny, nz,
                                   localSlab.globalZBegin, 1, 1,
                                   boundaryStream);
            }
            if (lastPlaneIsInterior) {
                launchStencilRange(input, output, nx, ny, nz,
                                   localSlab.globalZBegin, localSlab.planes,
                                   localSlab.planes, boundaryStream);
            }
        }

        std::swap(input, output);
    }

    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(interiorStream));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(boundaryStream));
    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
    double elapsed = 0.0;
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0,
                         MPI_COMM_WORLD));

    if (worldRank == 0) {
        std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", elapsed * 1000.0);
        const double cellUpdates = static_cast<double>(nx - 2) *
                                   static_cast<double>(ny - 2) *
                                   static_cast<double>(nz - 2) *
                                   static_cast<double>(iterations);
        const double mcups = elapsed > 0.0 ? cellUpdates / elapsed / 1e6 : 0.0;
        std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
    }

    std::vector<Real> localResult;
    if (printResults || validate) {
        size_t localResultElements = 0;
        if (!checkedMultiply(localSlab.planes, planeElements, localResultElements) ||
            localResultElements > static_cast<size_t>(LLONG_MAX)) {
            abortRun("local result size overflow", __FILE__, __LINE__);
        }
        localResult.resize(localResultElements);
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(localResult.data(), input + planeElements,
                              localResultElements * sizeof(Real),
                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    }

    if (printResults) {
        std::vector<Real> globalResult = gatherResult(localResult, nx, ny, nz,
                                                       worldRank, worldSize);
        if (worldRank == 0) {
            print_results(globalResult, "Grid");
        }
    }

    bool valid = true;
    if (validate) {
        if (worldRank == 0) {
            std::printf("Validating result...\n");
        }
        valid = validateDistributed(localResult, worldRank);
        if (worldRank == 0) {
            std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
        }
    }

    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(transferStream));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(boundaryStream));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(interiorStream));
    if (pinnedBase != nullptr) {
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(pinnedBase));
    }
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGrid2));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceGrid1));
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm));
    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
    return valid ? EXIT_SUCCESS : EXIT_FAILURE;
}

+[[noreturn]] void abortRun(const char* message, const char* file, int line) {
+    int initialized = 0;
+    MPI_Initialized(&initialized);
+    int rank = 0;
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    }
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s (%s:%d)\n", rank, message, file, line);
+    std::fflush(stderr);
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    std::abort();
+}

+void checkCuda(cudaError_t status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        char message[1024];
+        std::snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "CUDA call '%s' failed: %s", expression,
+                      cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        abortRun(message, file, line);
+    }
+}

+void checkMpi(int status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char error[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(status, error, &length);
+        char message[1024];
+        std::snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "MPI call '%s' failed: %.*s", expression,
+                      length, error);
+        abortRun(message, file, line);
+    }
+}

+Slab slabForRank(size_t nz, int ranks, int rank) {
+    const size_t rankCount = static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t rankIndex = static_cast<size_t>(rank);
+    const size_t quotient = nz / rankCount;
+    const size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    return {rankIndex * quotient + std::min(rankIndex, remainder),
+            quotient + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1U : 0U)};
+}

+__global__ void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,

+void launchStencilRange(const Real* input, Real* output, size_t nx, size_t ny,
+                        size_t globalNz, size_t globalZBegin, size_t localZBegin,
+                        size_t localZEnd, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (localZBegin > localZEnd || nx <= 2 || ny <= 2) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const dim3 block(kBlockX, kBlockY, 1);
+    const unsigned int gridX = static_cast<unsigned int>((nx - 2 + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX);
+    const unsigned int gridY = static_cast<unsigned int>((ny - 2 + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY);
+    constexpr size_t maxGridZ = 65535;
+
+    for (size_t first = localZBegin; first <= localZEnd;) {
+        const size_t planes = std::min(maxGridZ, localZEnd - first + 1);
+        const dim3 grid(gridX, gridY, static_cast<unsigned int>(planes));
+        stencilKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(input, output, nx, ny, globalNz,
+                                                  globalZBegin, first,
+                                                  first + planes - 1);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        first += planes;
+    }

+bool environmentFlag(const char* value, bool& parsedValue) {
+    if (value == nullptr) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (std::strcmp(value, "1") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "true") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "TRUE") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "on") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "ON") == 0) {
+        parsedValue = true;
+        return true;
+    }
+    if (std::strcmp(value, "0") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "false") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "FALSE") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "off") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "OFF") == 0) {
+        parsedValue = false;
+        return true;
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+bool detectCudaAwareMpi(int worldRank) {
+    bool enabled = false;
+#if defined(STENCIL3D_HAS_MPI_EXT) && defined(MPIX_CUDA_AWARE_SUPPORT)
+    enabled = MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
+#endif
+
+    const char* overrideValue = std::getenv("STENCIL3D_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
+    if (overrideValue != nullptr) {
+        bool requested = false;
+        if (environmentFlag(overrideValue, requested)) {
+            enabled = requested;
+        } else if (worldRank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "Warning: ignoring invalid STENCIL3D_CUDA_AWARE_MPI='%s'\n",
+                         overrideValue);
         }
     }
+
+    int local = enabled ? 1 : 0;
+    int allEnabled = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&local, &allEnabled, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    return allEnabled != 0;
+}

+void appendReceives(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests, Real* buffer, size_t elements,
+                    int peer, int tag) {
+    if (peer == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        return;
+    }
+    for (size_t offset = 0; offset < elements;) {
+        const int count = static_cast<int>(std::min(elements - offset,
+                                                    static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)));
+        requests.emplace_back(MPI_REQUEST_NULL);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(buffer + offset, count, MPI_DOUBLE, peer, tag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests.back()));
+        offset += static_cast<size_t>(count);
+    }
+}
+
+void appendSends(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests, const Real* buffer, size_t elements,
+                 int peer, int tag) {
+    if (peer == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        return;
+    }
+    for (size_t offset = 0; offset < elements;) {
+        const int count = static_cast<int>(std::min(elements - offset,
+                                                    static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)));
+        requests.emplace_back(MPI_REQUEST_NULL);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(buffer + offset, count, MPI_DOUBLE, peer, tag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests.back()));
+        offset += static_cast<size_t>(count);
+    }
 }

+void postHaloExchange(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests,
+                      Real* receiveLower, Real* receiveUpper,
+                      const Real* sendLower, const Real* sendUpper,
+                      size_t planeElements, int lowerRank, int upperRank) {
+    requests.clear();
+    appendReceives(requests, receiveLower, planeElements, lowerRank,

+void waitForRequests(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests) {
+    if (requests.empty()) {
+        return;
+    }
+    if (requests.size() > static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+        abortRun("too many MPI requests", __FILE__, __LINE__);
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(),
+                          MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));

+std::vector<Real> gatherResult(const std::vector<Real>& localResult, size_t nx,
+                               size_t ny, size_t nz, int worldRank, int worldSize) {
+    size_t planeElements = 0;

+        !checkedMultiply(planeElements, nz, globalElements)) {

+    std::memcpy(result.data() + rootSlab.globalZBegin * planeElements,
+                localResult.data(), localResult.size() * sizeof(Real));

+        receiveInChunks(result.data() + slab.globalZBegin * planeElements,
+                        slab.planes * planeElements, rank, kResultTag);
+    }
+    return result;

+[[noreturn]] void abortRun(const char* message, const char* file, int line) {
+    int initialized = 0;
+    MPI_Initialized(&initialized);
+    int rank = 0;
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    }
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s (%s:%d)\n", rank, message, file, line);
+    std::fflush(stderr);
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    std::abort();
+}

+void checkCuda(cudaError_t status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        char message[1024];
+        std::snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "CUDA call '%s' failed: %s", expression,
+                      cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        abortRun(message, file, line);
+    }
+}
+
+void checkMpi(int status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char error[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(status, error, &length);
+        char message[1024];
+        std::snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "MPI call '%s' failed: %.*s", expression,
+                      length, error);
+        abortRun(message, file, line);
+    }
+}

+#define CUDA_CHECK(call) checkCuda((call), #call, __FILE__, __LINE__)
+#define MPI_CHECK(call) checkMpi((call), #call, __FILE__, __LINE__)

+bool checkedMultiply(size_t lhs, size_t rhs, size_t& result) {
+    if (lhs != 0 && rhs > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / lhs) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    result = lhs * rhs;
+    return true;
+}

+bool parseSize(const char* text, size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}
+
+bool parseIterations(const char* text, int& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+struct Slab {

+Slab slabForRank(size_t nz, int ranks, int rank) {
+    const size_t rankCount = static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t rankIndex = static_cast<size_t>(rank);
+    const size_t quotient = nz / rankCount;
+    const size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    return {rankIndex * quotient + std::min(rankIndex, remainder),
+            quotient + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1U : 0U)};
 }

+void launchStencilRange(const Real* input, Real* output, size_t nx, size_t ny,
+                        size_t globalNz, size_t globalZBegin, size_t localZBegin,
+                        size_t localZEnd, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (localZBegin > localZEnd || nx <= 2 || ny <= 2) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const dim3 block(kBlockX, kBlockY, 1);
+    const unsigned int gridX = static_cast<unsigned int>((nx - 2 + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX);
+    const unsigned int gridY = static_cast<unsigned int>((ny - 2 + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY);
+    constexpr size_t maxGridZ = 65535;
+
+    for (size_t first = localZBegin; first <= localZEnd;) {
+        const size_t planes = std::min(maxGridZ, localZEnd - first + 1);
+        const dim3 grid(gridX, gridY, static_cast<unsigned int>(planes));
+        stencilKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(input, output, nx, ny, globalNz,
+                                                  globalZBegin, first,
+                                                  first + planes - 1);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        first += planes;
+    }
+}

+bool environmentFlag(const char* value, bool& parsedValue) {
+    if (value == nullptr) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (std::strcmp(value, "1") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "true") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "TRUE") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "on") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "ON") == 0) {
+        parsedValue = true;
+        return true;
+    }
+    if (std::strcmp(value, "0") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "false") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "FALSE") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "off") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "OFF") == 0) {
+        parsedValue = false;
+        return true;
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+bool detectCudaAwareMpi(int worldRank) {
+    bool enabled = false;
+#if defined(STENCIL3D_HAS_MPI_EXT) && defined(MPIX_CUDA_AWARE_SUPPORT)
+    enabled = MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
+#endif
+
+    const char* overrideValue = std::getenv("STENCIL3D_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
+    if (overrideValue != nullptr) {
+        bool requested = false;
+        if (environmentFlag(overrideValue, requested)) {
+            enabled = requested;
+        } else if (worldRank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "Warning: ignoring invalid STENCIL3D_CUDA_AWARE_MPI='%s'\n",
+                         overrideValue);
         }
     }
+
+    int local = enabled ? 1 : 0;
+    int allEnabled = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&local, &allEnabled, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    return allEnabled != 0;

+void appendReceives(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests, Real* buffer, size_t elements,
+                    int peer, int tag) {
+    if (peer == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        return;
+    }
+    for (size_t offset = 0; offset < elements;) {
+        const int count = static_cast<int>(std::min(elements - offset,
+                                                    static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)));
+        requests.emplace_back(MPI_REQUEST_NULL);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(buffer + offset, count, MPI_DOUBLE, peer, tag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests.back()));
+        offset += static_cast<size_t>(count);
+    }
 }

+std::vector<Real> gatherResult(const std::vector<Real>& localResult, size_t nx,
+                               size_t ny, size_t nz, int worldRank, int worldSize) {
+    size_t planeElements = 0;
+    size_t globalElements = 0;
+    if (!checkedMultiply(nx, ny, planeElements) ||
+        !checkedMultiply(planeElements, nz, globalElements)) {
+        abortRun("global result size overflow", __FILE__, __LINE__);
+    }
+
+    if (worldRank != 0) {
+        sendInChunks(localResult.data(), localResult.size(), 0, kResultTag);
+        return {};
+    }
+
+    std::vector<Real> result(globalElements);
+    const Slab rootSlab = slabForRank(nz, worldSize, 0);
+    std::memcpy(result.data() + rootSlab.globalZBegin * planeElements,
+                localResult.data(), localResult.size() * sizeof(Real));
+
+    for (int rank = 1; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+        const Slab slab = slabForRank(nz, worldSize, rank);
+        receiveInChunks(result.data() + slab.globalZBegin * planeElements,
+                        slab.planes * planeElements, rank, kResultTag);
+    }
+    return result;
 }

+[[noreturn]] void abortRun(const char* message, const char* file, int line) {
+    int initialized = 0;
+    MPI_Initialized(&initialized);
+    int rank = 0;
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    }
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s (%s:%d)\n", rank, message, file, line);
+    std::fflush(stderr);
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    std::abort();

+void checkCuda(cudaError_t status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        char message[1024];
+        std::snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "CUDA call '%s' failed: %s", expression,
+                      cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        abortRun(message, file, line);
+    }
+}

+void checkMpi(int status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char error[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(status, error, &length);
+        char message[1024];
+        std::snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "MPI call '%s' failed: %.*s", expression,
+                      length, error);
+        abortRun(message, file, line);
+    }
+}

+bool checkedMultiply(size_t lhs, size_t rhs, size_t& result) {
+    if (lhs != 0 && rhs > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / lhs) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    result = lhs * rhs;
+    return true;

+bool parseSize(const char* text, size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+bool parseIterations(const char* text, int& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
+    return true;

+Slab slabForRank(size_t nz, int ranks, int rank) {
+    const size_t rankCount = static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t rankIndex = static_cast<size_t>(rank);
+    const size_t quotient = nz / rankCount;
+    const size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    return {rankIndex * quotient + std::min(rankIndex, remainder),
+            quotient + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1U : 0U)};

+__global__ void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                              Real* __restrict__ output,
+                              size_t nx, size_t ny, size_t globalNz,

+void launchStencilRange(const Real* input, Real* output, size_t nx, size_t ny,
+                        size_t globalNz, size_t globalZBegin, size_t localZBegin,
+                        size_t localZEnd, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (localZBegin > localZEnd || nx <= 2 || ny <= 2) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const dim3 block(kBlockX, kBlockY, 1);
+    const unsigned int gridX = static_cast<unsigned int>((nx - 2 + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX);
+    const unsigned int gridY = static_cast<unsigned int>((ny - 2 + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY);
+    constexpr size_t maxGridZ = 65535;
+
+    for (size_t first = localZBegin; first <= localZEnd;) {
+        const size_t planes = std::min(maxGridZ, localZEnd - first + 1);
+        const dim3 grid(gridX, gridY, static_cast<unsigned int>(planes));
+        stencilKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(input, output, nx, ny, globalNz,
+                                                  globalZBegin, first,
+                                                  first + planes - 1);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        first += planes;
+    }
+}

+bool environmentFlag(const char* value, bool& parsedValue) {
+    if (value == nullptr) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (std::strcmp(value, "1") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "true") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "TRUE") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "on") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "ON") == 0) {
+        parsedValue = true;
+        return true;
+    }
+    if (std::strcmp(value, "0") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "false") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "FALSE") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "off") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "OFF") == 0) {
+        parsedValue = false;
+        return true;
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+bool detectCudaAwareMpi(int worldRank) {
+    bool enabled = false;
+#if defined(STENCIL3D_HAS_MPI_EXT) && defined(MPIX_CUDA_AWARE_SUPPORT)
+    enabled = MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
+#endif
+
+    const char* overrideValue = std::getenv("STENCIL3D_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
+    if (overrideValue != nullptr) {
+        bool requested = false;
+        if (environmentFlag(overrideValue, requested)) {
+            enabled = requested;
+        } else if (worldRank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "Warning: ignoring invalid STENCIL3D_CUDA_AWARE_MPI='%s'\n",
+                         overrideValue);
         }
     }
+
+    int local = enabled ? 1 : 0;
+    int allEnabled = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&local, &allEnabled, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    return allEnabled != 0;
+}

+void appendReceives(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests, Real* buffer, size_t elements,
+                    int peer, int tag) {
+    if (peer == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        return;
+    }
+    for (size_t offset = 0; offset < elements;) {
+        const int count = static_cast<int>(std::min(elements - offset,
+                                                    static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)));
+        requests.emplace_back(MPI_REQUEST_NULL);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(buffer + offset, count, MPI_DOUBLE, peer, tag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests.back()));
+        offset += static_cast<size_t>(count);
+    }
 }

+[[noreturn]] void abortRun(const char* message, const char* file, int line) {
+    int initialized = 0;
+    MPI_Initialized(&initialized);
+    int rank = 0;
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    }
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s (%s:%d)\n", rank, message, file, line);
+    std::fflush(stderr);
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    std::abort();

+void checkCuda(cudaError_t status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        char message[1024];
+        std::snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "CUDA call '%s' failed: %s", expression,
+                      cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        abortRun(message, file, line);
+    }
+}

+void checkMpi(int status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char error[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(status, error, &length);
+        char message[1024];
+        std::snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "MPI call '%s' failed: %.*s", expression,
+                      length, error);
+        abortRun(message, file, line);
+    }
+}

+bool checkedMultiply(size_t lhs, size_t rhs, size_t& result) {
+    if (lhs != 0 && rhs > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / lhs) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    result = lhs * rhs;
+    return true;

+bool parseSize(const char* text, size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {

+Slab slabForRank(size_t nz, int ranks, int rank) {

+__global__ void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                              Real* __restrict__ output,
+                              size_t nx, size_t ny, size_t globalNz,
+                              size_t globalZBegin, size_t localZBegin,

+    const size_t localZ = localZBegin + blockIdx.z;

+

+    if (valid) {
+        index = localZ * planeElements + y * nx + x;
+        tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x + 1] = input[index];
+
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+            tile[threadIdx.y + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
+        }
+        if (threadIdx.x == kBlockX - 1 || x == nx - 2) {
+            tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x + 2] = input[index + 1];
+        }
+        if (threadIdx.y == 0) {
+            tile[0][threadIdx.x + 1] = input[index - nx];
+        }
+        if (threadIdx.y == kBlockY - 1 || y == ny - 2) {
+            tile[threadIdx.y + 2][threadIdx.x + 1] = input[index + nx];
         }

-                if (x == 0 || x == nx-1 || y == 0 || y == ny-1 || z == 0 || z == nz-1) {
-                    const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
-                    output[idx] = input[idx];
-                }
-            }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (!valid) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t globalZ = globalZBegin + localZ - 1;
+    if (globalZ == 0 || globalZ + 1 == globalNz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    Real sum = tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x + 1];
+    sum += tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x];
+    sum += tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x + 2];

+void launchStencilRange(const Real* input, Real* output, size_t nx, size_t ny,
+                        size_t globalNz, size_t globalZBegin, size_t localZBegin,
+                        size_t localZEnd, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (localZBegin > localZEnd || nx <= 2 || ny <= 2) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const dim3 block(kBlockX, kBlockY, 1);
+    const unsigned int gridX = static_cast<unsigned int>((nx - 2 + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX);
+    const unsigned int gridY = static_cast<unsigned int>((ny - 2 + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY);
+    constexpr size_t maxGridZ = 65535;
+
+    for (size_t first = localZBegin; first <= localZEnd;) {
+        const size_t planes = std::min(maxGridZ, localZEnd - first + 1);
+        const dim3 grid(gridX, gridY, static_cast<unsigned int>(planes));
+        stencilKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(input, output, nx, ny, globalNz,
+                                                  globalZBegin, first,
+                                                  first + planes - 1);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        first += planes;
+    }
+}

+bool environmentFlag(const char* value, bool& parsedValue) {
+    if (value == nullptr) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (std::strcmp(value, "1") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "true") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "TRUE") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "on") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "ON") == 0) {
+        parsedValue = true;
+        return true;
+    }
+    if (std::strcmp(value, "0") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "false") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "FALSE") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "off") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "OFF") == 0) {
+        parsedValue = false;
+        return true;
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+void appendReceives(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests, Real* buffer, size_t elements,
+                    int peer, int tag) {
+    if (peer == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        return;
+    }
+    for (size_t offset = 0; offset < elements;) {
+        const int count = static_cast<int>(std::min(elements - offset,
+                                                    static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)));
+        requests.emplace_back(MPI_REQUEST_NULL);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(buffer + offset, count, MPI_DOUBLE, peer, tag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests.back()));
+        offset += static_cast<size_t>(count);
+    }
 }

+std::vector<Real> gatherResult(const std::vector<Real>& localResult, size_t nx,
+                               size_t ny, size_t nz, int worldRank, int worldSize) {

+[[noreturn]] void abortRun(const char* message, const char* file, int line) {
+    int initialized = 0;
+    MPI_Initialized(&initialized);
+    int rank = 0;
+    if (initialized) {

+    }

+    std::fflush(stderr);
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    std::abort();

+void checkCuda(cudaError_t status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        char message[1024];
+        std::snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "CUDA call '%s' failed: %s", expression,
+                      cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        abortRun(message, file, line);
+    }
+}

+void checkMpi(int status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char error[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(status, error, &length);
+        char message[1024];
+        std::snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "MPI call '%s' failed: %.*s", expression,
+                      length, error);
+        abortRun(message, file, line);
+    }
+}

+bool checkedMultiply(size_t lhs, size_t rhs, size_t& result) {
+    if (lhs != 0 && rhs > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / lhs) {

+bool parseSize(const char* text, size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+bool parseIterations(const char* text, int& value) {

+        return false;

+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;

+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);

+void launchStencilRange(const Real* input, Real* output, size_t nx, size_t ny,
+                        size_t globalNz, size_t globalZBegin, size_t localZBegin,
+                        size_t localZEnd, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (localZBegin > localZEnd || nx <= 2 || ny <= 2) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const dim3 block(kBlockX, kBlockY, 1);
+    const unsigned int gridX = static_cast<unsigned int>((nx - 2 + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX);
+    const unsigned int gridY = static_cast<unsigned int>((ny - 2 + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY);
+    constexpr size_t maxGridZ = 65535;
+
+    for (size_t first = localZBegin; first <= localZEnd;) {
+        const size_t planes = std::min(maxGridZ, localZEnd - first + 1);
+        const dim3 grid(gridX, gridY, static_cast<unsigned int>(planes));
+        stencilKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(input, output, nx, ny, globalNz,
+                                                  globalZBegin, first,
+                                                  first + planes - 1);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        first += planes;
+    }

+bool environmentFlag(const char* value, bool& parsedValue) {

+        std::strcmp(value, "FALSE") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "off") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "OFF") == 0) {

+void appendReceives(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests, Real* buffer, size_t elements,
+                    int peer, int tag) {
+    if (peer == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        return;
+    }
+    for (size_t offset = 0; offset < elements;) {
+        const int count = static_cast<int>(std::min(elements - offset,
+                                                    static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)));
+        requests.emplace_back(MPI_REQUEST_NULL);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(buffer + offset, count, MPI_DOUBLE, peer, tag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests.back()));
+        offset += static_cast<size_t>(count);
+    }
 }

+void postHaloExchange(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests,
+                      Real* receiveLower, Real* receiveUpper,
+                      const Real* sendLower, const Real* sendUpper,
+                      size_t planeElements, int lowerRank, int upperRank) {
+    requests.clear();
+    appendReceives(requests, receiveLower, planeElements, lowerRank,
+                   kHaloFromLowerTag);
+    appendReceives(requests, receiveUpper, planeElements, upperRank,
+                   kHaloFromUpperTag);
+    appendSends(requests, sendUpper, planeElements, upperRank,
+                kHaloFromLowerTag);
+    appendSends(requests, sendLower, planeElements, lowerRank,
+                kHaloFromUpperTag);

+void waitForRequests(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests) {
+    if (requests.empty()) {
+        return;
+    }
+    if (requests.size() > static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+        abortRun("too many MPI requests", __FILE__, __LINE__);
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(),
+                          MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+}

+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<Real>& localResult, int worldRank) {
+    Real localMin = std::numeric_limits<Real>::infinity();
+    Real localMax = -std::numeric_limits<Real>::infinity();
+    int localInvalid = 0;
+    const long long elements = static_cast<long long>(localResult.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
+    for (long long i = 0; i < elements; ++i) {
+        const Real value = localResult[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
+        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
+        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
+        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
+    }
+
+    Real globalMin = 0.0;

+[[noreturn]] void abortRun(const char* message, const char* file, int line) {
+    int initialized = 0;
+    MPI_Initialized(&initialized);
+    int rank = 0;
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    }
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s (%s:%d)\n", rank, message, file, line);
+    std::fflush(stderr);
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    std::abort();
+}

+void checkCuda(cudaError_t status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        char message[1024];
+        std::snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "CUDA call '%s' failed: %s", expression,
+                      cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        abortRun(message, file, line);
+    }
+}
+
+void checkMpi(int status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char error[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(status, error, &length);
+        char message[1024];
+        std::snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "MPI call '%s' failed: %.*s", expression,
+                      length, error);
+        abortRun(message, file, line);
+    }
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call) checkCuda((call), #call, __FILE__, __LINE__)
+#define MPI_CHECK(call) checkMpi((call), #call, __FILE__, __LINE__)

+bool checkedMultiply(size_t lhs, size_t rhs, size_t& result) {
+    if (lhs != 0 && rhs > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / lhs) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    result = lhs * rhs;
+    return true;
+}
+
+bool parseSize(const char* text, size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}
+
+bool parseIterations(const char* text, int& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}

+struct Slab {
+    size_t globalZBegin;
+    size_t planes;
+};
+
+Slab slabForRank(size_t nz, int ranks, int rank) {
+    const size_t rankCount = static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t rankIndex = static_cast<size_t>(rank);
+    const size_t quotient = nz / rankCount;
+    const size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    return {rankIndex * quotient + std::min(rankIndex, remainder),
+            quotient + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1U : 0U)};
 }

+                              Real* __restrict__ output,
+                              size_t nx, size_t ny, size_t globalNz,

+void launchStencilRange(const Real* input, Real* output, size_t nx, size_t ny,
+                        size_t globalNz, size_t globalZBegin, size_t localZBegin,
+                        size_t localZEnd, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (localZBegin > localZEnd || nx <= 2 || ny <= 2) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const dim3 block(kBlockX, kBlockY, 1);
+    const unsigned int gridX = static_cast<unsigned int>((nx - 2 + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX);
+    const unsigned int gridY = static_cast<unsigned int>((ny - 2 + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY);
+    constexpr size_t maxGridZ = 65535;
+
+    for (size_t first = localZBegin; first <= localZEnd;) {
+        const size_t planes = std::min(maxGridZ, localZEnd - first + 1);
+        const dim3 grid(gridX, gridY, static_cast<unsigned int>(planes));
+        stencilKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(input, output, nx, ny, globalNz,
+                                                  globalZBegin, first,
+                                                  first + planes - 1);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        first += planes;
+    }
+}

+bool environmentFlag(const char* value, bool& parsedValue) {
+    if (value == nullptr) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (std::strcmp(value, "1") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "true") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "TRUE") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "on") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "ON") == 0) {
+        parsedValue = true;
+        return true;
+    }
+    if (std::strcmp(value, "0") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "false") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "FALSE") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "off") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "OFF") == 0) {
+        parsedValue = false;
+        return true;
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+bool detectCudaAwareMpi(int worldRank) {
+    bool enabled = false;
+#if defined(STENCIL3D_HAS_MPI_EXT) && defined(MPIX_CUDA_AWARE_SUPPORT)
+    enabled = MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
+#endif
+
+    const char* overrideValue = std::getenv("STENCIL3D_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
+    if (overrideValue != nullptr) {
+        bool requested = false;
+        if (environmentFlag(overrideValue, requested)) {
+            enabled = requested;
+        } else if (worldRank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "Warning: ignoring invalid STENCIL3D_CUDA_AWARE_MPI='%s'\n",
+                         overrideValue);
         }
     }
+
+    int local = enabled ? 1 : 0;
+    int allEnabled = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&local, &allEnabled, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    return allEnabled != 0;
+}

+void appendReceives(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests, Real* buffer, size_t elements,
+                    int peer, int tag) {
+    if (peer == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        return;
+    }
+    for (size_t offset = 0; offset < elements;) {
+        const int count = static_cast<int>(std::min(elements - offset,
+                                                    static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)));
+        requests.emplace_back(MPI_REQUEST_NULL);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(buffer + offset, count, MPI_DOUBLE, peer, tag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests.back()));
+        offset += static_cast<size_t>(count);
+    }
 }

+void postHaloExchange(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests,
+                      Real* receiveLower, Real* receiveUpper,
+                      const Real* sendLower, const Real* sendUpper,
+                      size_t planeElements, int lowerRank, int upperRank) {
+    requests.clear();
+    appendReceives(requests, receiveLower, planeElements, lowerRank,
+                   kHaloFromLowerTag);
+    appendReceives(requests, receiveUpper, planeElements, upperRank,
+                   kHaloFromUpperTag);
+    appendSends(requests, sendUpper, planeElements, upperRank,
+                kHaloFromLowerTag);
+    appendSends(requests, sendLower, planeElements, lowerRank,
+                kHaloFromUpperTag);

+void waitForRequests(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests) {
+    if (requests.empty()) {

+        abortRun("too many MPI requests", __FILE__, __LINE__);
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(),
+                          MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));

+std::vector<Real> gatherResult(const std::vector<Real>& localResult, size_t nx,
+                               size_t ny, size_t nz, int worldRank, int worldSize) {
+    size_t planeElements = 0;
+    size_t globalElements = 0;
+    if (!checkedMultiply(nx, ny, planeElements) ||
+        !checkedMultiply(planeElements, nz, globalElements)) {
+        abortRun("global result size overflow", __FILE__, __LINE__);
+    }
+
+    if (worldRank != 0) {
+        sendInChunks(localResult.data(), localResult.size(), 0, kResultTag);
+        return {};
+    }
+
+    std::vector<Real> result(globalElements);
+    const Slab rootSlab = slabForRank(nz, worldSize, 0);
+    std::memcpy(result.data() + rootSlab.globalZBegin * planeElements,
+                localResult.data(), localResult.size() * sizeof(Real));
+
+    for (int rank = 1; rank < worldSize; ++rank) {
+        const Slab slab = slabForRank(nz, worldSize, rank);
+        receiveInChunks(result.data() + slab.globalZBegin * planeElements,
+                        slab.planes * planeElements, rank, kResultTag);
+    }
+    return result;
 }

   130	Slab slabForRank(size_t nz, int ranks, int rank) {
   131	    const size_t rankCount = static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
   132	    const size_t rankIndex = static_cast<size_t>(rank);
   133	    const size_t quotient = nz / rankCount;
   134	    const size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
   135	    return {rankIndex * quotient + std::min(rankIndex, remainder),
   136	            quotient + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1U : 0U)};
   137	}

   139	void initializeLocalGrid(std::vector<Real>& grid, size_t planeElements,
   140	                         size_t globalZBegin, size_t localPlanes) {
   141	    const long long count = static_cast<long long>(localPlanes);
   142	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   143	    for (long long plane = 0; plane < count; ++plane) {
   144	        const size_t localZ = static_cast<size_t>(plane) + 1;
   145	        const size_t globalZ = globalZBegin + static_cast<size_t>(plane);
   146	        const size_t localOffset = localZ * planeElements;
   147	        const size_t globalOffset = globalZ * planeElements;
   148	        for (size_t cell = 0; cell < planeElements; ++cell) {
   149	            grid[localOffset + cell] = static_cast<Real>((globalOffset + cell) % 19U);
   150	        }
   151	    }
   152	}

   154	__global__ void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
   155	                              Real* __restrict__ output,
   156	                              size_t nx, size_t ny, size_t globalNz,
   157	                              size_t globalZBegin, size_t localZBegin,
   158	                              size_t localZEnd) {
   159	    __shared__ Real tile[kBlockY + 2][kBlockX + 2];
   160	
   161	    const size_t x = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x + 1;
   162	    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y + 1;
   163	    const size_t localZ = localZBegin + blockIdx.z;
   164	    const bool valid = x + 1 < nx && y + 1 < ny && localZ <= localZEnd;
   165	    const size_t planeElements = nx * ny;
   166	
   167	    size_t index = 0;
   168	    if (valid) {
   169	        index = localZ * planeElements + y * nx + x;
   170	        tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x + 1] = input[index];
   171	
   172	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
   173	            tile[threadIdx.y + 1][0] = input[index - 1];
   174	        }
   175	        if (threadIdx.x == kBlockX - 1 || x == nx - 2) {
   176	            tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x + 2] = input[index + 1];
   177	        }
   178	        if (threadIdx.y == 0) {
   179	            tile[0][threadIdx.x + 1] = input[index - nx];
   180	        }
   181	        if (threadIdx.y == kBlockY - 1 || y == ny - 2) {
   182	            tile[threadIdx.y + 2][threadIdx.x + 1] = input[index + nx];
   183	        }
   184	    }
   185	    __syncthreads();
   186	
   187	    if (!valid) {
   188	        return;
   189	    }
   190	
   191	    const size_t globalZ = globalZBegin + localZ - 1;
   192	    if (globalZ == 0 || globalZ + 1 == globalNz) {
   193	        return;
   194	    }
   195	
   196	    Real sum = tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x + 1];
   197	    sum += tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x];
   198	    sum += tile[threadIdx.y + 1][threadIdx.x + 2];
   199	    sum += tile[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x + 1];
   200	    sum += tile[threadIdx.y + 2][threadIdx.x + 1];
   201	    sum += input[index - planeElements];
   202	    sum += input[index + planeElements];
   203	    output[index] = sum / Real{7.0};

   206	void launchStencilRange(const Real* input, Real* output, size_t nx, size_t ny,
   207	                        size_t globalNz, size_t globalZBegin, size_t localZBegin,
   208	                        size_t localZEnd, cudaStream_t stream) {
   209	    if (localZBegin > localZEnd || nx <= 2 || ny <= 2) {
   210	        return;
   211	    }
   212	
   213	    const dim3 block(kBlockX, kBlockY, 1);
   214	    const unsigned int gridX = static_cast<unsigned int>((nx - 2 + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX);
   215	    const unsigned int gridY = static_cast<unsigned int>((ny - 2 + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY);
   216	    constexpr size_t maxGridZ = 65535;
   217	
   218	    for (size_t first = localZBegin; first <= localZEnd;) {
   219	        const size_t planes = std::min(maxGridZ, localZEnd - first + 1);

   222	                                                  globalZBegin, first,

   224	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());

   270	}

   272	void appendReceives(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests, Real* buffer, size_t elements,
   273	                    int peer, int tag) {
   274	    if (peer == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   275	        return;
   276	    }
   277	    for (size_t offset = 0; offset < elements;) {
   278	        const int count = static_cast<int>(std::min(elements - offset,
   279	                                                    static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)));
   280	        requests.emplace_back(MPI_REQUEST_NULL);
   281	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(buffer + offset, count, MPI_DOUBLE, peer, tag,
   282	                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests.back()));
   283	        offset += static_cast<size_t>(count);
   284	    }
   285	}
   286	
   287	void appendSends(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests, const Real* buffer, size_t elements,
   288	                 int peer, int tag) {
   289	    if (peer == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   290	        return;
   291	    }
   292	    for (size_t offset = 0; offset < elements;) {
   293	        const int count = static_cast<int>(std::min(elements - offset,
   294	                                                    static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)));
   295	        requests.emplace_back(MPI_REQUEST_NULL);
   296	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(buffer + offset, count, MPI_DOUBLE, peer, tag,
   297	                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests.back()));
   298	        offset += static_cast<size_t>(count);
   299	    }
   300	}
   301	
   302	void postHaloExchange(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests,
   303	                      Real* receiveLower, Real* receiveUpper,
   304	                      const Real* sendLower, const Real* sendUpper,
   305	                      size_t planeElements, int lowerRank, int upperRank) {
   306	    requests.clear();
   307	    appendReceives(requests, receiveLower, planeElements, lowerRank,
   308	                   kHaloFromLowerTag);
   309	    appendReceives(requests, receiveUpper, planeElements, upperRank,
   310	                   kHaloFromUpperTag);
   311	    appendSends(requests, sendUpper, planeElements, upperRank,
   312	                kHaloFromLowerTag);
   313	    appendSends(requests, sendLower, planeElements, lowerRank,
   314	                kHaloFromUpperTag);
   315	}
   316	
   317	void waitForRequests(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests) {
   318	    if (requests.empty()) {
   319	        return;
   320	    }
   321	    if (requests.size() > static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
   322	        abortRun("too many MPI requests", __FILE__, __LINE__);
   323	    }
   324	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(),
   325	                          MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
   326	}
   327	
   328	bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<Real>& localResult, int worldRank) {
   329	    Real localMin = std::numeric_limits<Real>::infinity();
   330	    Real localMax = -std::numeric_limits<Real>::infinity();
   331	    int localInvalid = 0;
   332	    const long long elements = static_cast<long long>(localResult.size());
   333	
   334	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(min : localMin) reduction(max : localMax) reduction(| : localInvalid)
   335	    for (long long i = 0; i < elements; ++i) {
   336	        const Real value = localResult[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
   337	        localMin = std::min(localMin, value);
   338	        localMax = std::max(localMax, value);
   339	        localInvalid |= !std::isfinite(value);
   340	    }
   341	
   342	    Real globalMin = 0.0;
   343	    Real globalMax = 0.0;
   344	    int globalInvalid = 0;
   345	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMin, &globalMin, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN,
   346	                            MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   347	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localMax, &globalMax, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX,
   348	                            MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   349	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&localInvalid, &globalInvalid, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MAX,
   350	                            MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   351	
   352	    if (worldRank == 0) {
   353	        if (globalInvalid != 0) {
   354	            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
   355	        }
   356	        std::printf("Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", globalMin, globalMax);
   357	        if (globalMax > 1e6 || globalMin < -1e6) {
   358	            std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
   359	        }
   360	    }
   440	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   441	        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-x") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   442	            argumentsValid &= parseSize(argv[++i], nx);
   443	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-y") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   444	            argumentsValid &= parseSize(argv[++i], ny);
   445	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-z") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   446	            argumentsValid &= parseSize(argv[++i], nz);
   447	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-i") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   448	            argumentsValid &= parseIterations(argv[++i], iterations);
   449	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
   450	            validate = true;
   451	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
   452	            printResults = true;
   453	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
   454	            showHelp = true;
   455	        } else {
   456	            argumentsValid = false;
   457	            if (worldRank == 0) {
   458	                std::fprintf(stderr, "Unknown or incomplete option: %s\n", argv[i]);
   459	            }
   460	        }
   461	    }
   462	
   463	    if (showHelp) {
   464	        if (worldRank == 0) {
   465	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   466	        }
   467	        MPI_Finalize();
   468	        return EXIT_SUCCESS;
   469	    }
   470	
   471	    if (ny == 0) {
   472	        ny = nx;
   473	    }
   474	    if (nz == 0) {
   475	        nz = nx;
   476	    }
   477	
   478	    size_t planeElements = 0;
   479	    size_t globalElements = 0;
   480	    argumentsValid &= nx >= 2 && ny >= 2 && nz >= 2;
   481	    argumentsValid &= static_cast<size_t>(worldSize) <= nz;
   482	    argumentsValid &= checkedMultiply(nx, ny, planeElements);
   483	    argumentsValid &= argumentsValid && checkedMultiply(planeElements, nz, globalElements);
   484	    argumentsValid &= nz <= static_cast<size_t>(LLONG_MAX);
   485	
   486	    if (!argumentsValid) {
   487	        if (worldRank == 0) {
   488	            std::fprintf(stderr,
   489	                         "Invalid configuration: dimensions must be at least 2, sizes must "
   490	                         "not overflow, and MPI ranks must not exceed Z planes.\n");
   491	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   492	        }
   493	        MPI_Finalize();
   494	        return EXIT_FAILURE;
   495	    }
   496	
   497	    MPI_Comm nodeComm = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   498	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, worldRank,
   499	                                  MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm));
   500	    int nodeRank = 0;
   501	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &nodeRank));
   502	
   503	    int deviceCount = 0;
   504	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
   505	    if (deviceCount <= 0) {
   506	        abortRun("no CUDA device is visible", __FILE__, __LINE__);
   507	    }
   508	    const int device = nodeRank % deviceCount;
   509	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
   510	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
   511	
   512	    cudaDeviceProp deviceProperties{};
   513	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&deviceProperties, device));
   514	    const size_t gridX = (nx - 2 + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX;
   515	    const size_t gridY = (ny - 2 + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY;
   516	    if (gridX > static_cast<size_t>(deviceProperties.maxGridSize[0]) ||
   517	        gridY > static_cast<size_t>(deviceProperties.maxGridSize[1])) {
   518	        abortRun("X/Y dimensions exceed CUDA launch limits", __FILE__, __LINE__);
   519	    }
   520	
   521	    const bool cudaAwareMpi = detectCudaAwareMpi(worldRank);
   522	    const Slab localSlab = slabForRank(nz, worldSize, worldRank);
   523	    size_t allocationPlanes = localSlab.planes + 2;
   524	    size_t allocationElements = 0;
   525	    size_t allocationBytes = 0;
   526	    size_t planeBytes = 0;
   527	    if (!checkedMultiply(allocationPlanes, planeElements, allocationElements) ||
   528	        !checkedMultiply(allocationElements, sizeof(Real), allocationBytes) ||
   529	        !checkedMultiply(planeElements, sizeof(Real), planeBytes) ||
   530	        localSlab.planes > static_cast<size_t>(LLONG_MAX)) {
   531	        abortRun("local allocation size overflow", __FILE__, __LINE__);
   532	    }
   533	
   534	    if (worldRank == 0) {
   535	        std::printf("3D Stencil Benchmark\n");
   536	        std::printf("Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\n", nx, ny, nz);
   537	        std::printf("Iterations: %d\n", iterations);
   538	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   539	        std::printf("Parallelization: %d MPI rank%s, up to %d OpenMP thread%s/rank, CUDA\n",
   540	                    worldSize, worldSize == 1 ? "" : "s", omp_get_max_threads(),
   541	                    omp_get_max_threads() == 1 ? "" : "s");
   542	        std::printf("Rank 0 CUDA device: %s\n", deviceProperties.name);
   543	        std::printf("Halo transport: %s\n",
   544	                    worldSize == 1
   545	                        ? "none (single MPI rank)"
   546	                        : (cudaAwareMpi ? "CUDA-aware MPI device buffers"
   547	                                        : "MPI with pinned-host staging"));
   548	        std::printf("Initializing grid...\n");
   549	    }
   550	
   551	    std::vector<Real> initial(allocationElements, Real{0.0});
   552	    initializeLocalGrid(initial, planeElements, localSlab.globalZBegin,
   553	                        localSlab.planes);
   554	
   555	    Real* deviceGrid1 = nullptr;
   556	    Real* deviceGrid2 = nullptr;
   557	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceGrid1), allocationBytes));
   558	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceGrid2), allocationBytes));
   559	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(deviceGrid1, initial.data(), allocationBytes,
   560	                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   561	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(deviceGrid2, initial.data(), allocationBytes,
   562	                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   563	    std::vector<Real>().swap(initial);
   564	
   565	    Real* pinnedBase = nullptr;
   566	    Real* sendLowerHost = nullptr;
   567	    Real* sendUpperHost = nullptr;
   568	    Real* receiveLowerHost = nullptr;
   569	    Real* receiveUpperHost = nullptr;
   570	    if (!cudaAwareMpi && worldSize > 1) {
   571	        size_t stagingElements = 0;
   572	        size_t stagingBytes = 0;
   573	        if (!checkedMultiply(planeElements, size_t{4}, stagingElements) ||
   574	            !checkedMultiply(stagingElements, sizeof(Real), stagingBytes)) {
   575	            abortRun("halo staging size overflow", __FILE__, __LINE__);
   576	        }
   577	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pinnedBase), stagingBytes));
   578	        sendLowerHost = pinnedBase;
   579	        sendUpperHost = pinnedBase + planeElements;
   580	        receiveLowerHost = pinnedBase + 2 * planeElements;
   581	        receiveUpperHost = pinnedBase + 3 * planeElements;
   582	    }
   583	
   584	    cudaStream_t interiorStream = nullptr;
   585	    cudaStream_t boundaryStream = nullptr;
   586	    cudaStream_t transferStream = nullptr;
   587	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&interiorStream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   588	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&boundaryStream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   589	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&transferStream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   590	    cudaEvent_t interiorDone[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};
   591	    if (worldSize > 1) {
   592	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&interiorDone[0], cudaEventDisableTiming));
   593	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&interiorDone[1], cudaEventDisableTiming));
   594	    }
   595	
   596	    const int lowerRank = worldRank == 0 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : worldRank - 1;
   597	    const int upperRank = worldRank + 1 == worldSize ? MPI_PROC_NULL : worldRank + 1;
   598	    const size_t chunkCount = (planeElements + static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX) - 1) /
   599	                              static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX);
   600	    std::vector<MPI_Request> requests;
   601	    requests.reserve(4 * chunkCount);
   602	
   603	    Real* input = deviceGrid1;
   604	    Real* output = deviceGrid2;
   605	
   606	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   607	    if (worldRank == 0) {
   608	        std::printf("Running stencil computation...\n");
   609	    }
   610	    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
   611	
   612	    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < iterations; ++iteration) {
   613	        if (worldSize == 1) {
   614	            // A single rank has no halos: one stream supplies all temporal
   615	            // dependencies without a host synchronization per iteration.
   616	            launchStencilRange(input, output, nx, ny, nz, localSlab.globalZBegin,
   617	                               2, localSlab.planes - 1, interiorStream);
   618	            std::swap(input, output);
   619	            continue;
   620	        }
   621	
   622	        // These edge planes are produced on boundaryStream.  The middle from the
   623	        // preceding iteration may still finish while halo transfer is initiated.
   624	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(boundaryStream));
   625	
   626	        Real* receiveLower = input;
   627	        Real* receiveUpper = input + (localSlab.planes + 1) * planeElements;
   628	        const Real* sendLower = input + planeElements;
   629	        const Real* sendUpper = input + localSlab.planes * planeElements;
   630	
   631	        if (!cudaAwareMpi) {
   632	            if (lowerRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   633	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(sendLowerHost, sendLower, planeBytes,
   634	                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, transferStream));
   635	            }
   636	            if (upperRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   637	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(sendUpperHost, sendUpper, planeBytes,
   638	                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, transferStream));
   639	            }
   640	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(transferStream));
   641	            receiveLower = receiveLowerHost;
   642	            receiveUpper = receiveUpperHost;
   643	            sendLower = sendLowerHost;
   644	            sendUpper = sendUpperHost;
   645	        }
   646	
   647	        postHaloExchange(requests, receiveLower, receiveUpper, sendLower, sendUpper,
   648	                         planeElements, lowerRank, upperRank);
   649	
   650	        if (localSlab.planes > 2) {
   651	            launchStencilRange(input, output, nx, ny, nz, localSlab.globalZBegin,
   652	                               2, localSlab.planes - 1, interiorStream);
   653	        }
   654	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(interiorDone[iteration & 1], interiorStream));
   655	
   656	        waitForRequests(requests);
   657	
   658	        if (!cudaAwareMpi) {
   659	            if (lowerRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   660	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(input, receiveLowerHost, planeBytes,
   661	                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, boundaryStream));
   662	            }
   663	            if (upperRank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   664	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(
   665	                    input + (localSlab.planes + 1) * planeElements,
   666	                    receiveUpperHost, planeBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
   667	                                           boundaryStream));
   668	            }
   669	        }
   670	
   671	        // An edge plane reads the neighboring local plane.  Preserve that
   672	        // dependency on the preceding iteration on-device, allowing the CPU to
   673	        // drive MPI while the preceding and current middle kernels stay queued.
   674	        if (iteration != 0 && localSlab.planes > 2) {
   675	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(boundaryStream,
   676	                                           interiorDone[(iteration - 1) & 1], 0));
   677	        }
   678	
   679	        const bool firstPlaneIsInterior = localSlab.globalZBegin != 0;
   680	        const bool lastPlaneIsInterior =
   681	            localSlab.globalZBegin + localSlab.planes != nz;
   682	        if (localSlab.planes <= 2) {
   683	            const size_t first = firstPlaneIsInterior ? 1 : 2;
   684	            const size_t last = lastPlaneIsInterior
   685	                                    ? localSlab.planes
   686	                                    : localSlab.planes - 1;
   687	            launchStencilRange(input, output, nx, ny, nz, localSlab.globalZBegin,
   688	                               first, last, boundaryStream);
   689	        } else {
   690	            if (firstPlaneIsInterior) {
   691	                launchStencilRange(input, output, nx, ny, nz,
   692	                                   localSlab.globalZBegin, 1, 1,
   693	                                   boundaryStream);
   694	            }
   695	            if (lastPlaneIsInterior) {
   696	                launchStencilRange(input, output, nx, ny, nz,
   697	                                   localSlab.globalZBegin, localSlab.planes,
   698	                                   localSlab.planes, boundaryStream);
   699	            }
   700	        }
   701	
   702	        std::swap(input, output);
   703	    }
   704	
   705	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(interiorStream));
   706	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(boundaryStream));
   707	    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
   708	    double elapsed = 0.0;
   709	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0,
   710	                         MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   711	
   712	    if (worldRank == 0) {
   713	        std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", elapsed * 1000.0);
   714	        const double cellUpdates = static_cast<double>(nx - 2) *
   715	                                   static_cast<double>(ny - 2) *
   716	                                   static_cast<double>(nz - 2) *
   717	                                   static_cast<double>(iterations);
   718	        const double mcups = elapsed > 0.0 ? cellUpdates / elapsed / 1e6 : 0.0;
   719	        std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
   720	    }
   721	
   722	    std::vector<Real> localResult;
   723	    if (printResults || validate) {
   724	        size_t localResultElements = 0;
   725	        if (!checkedMultiply(localSlab.planes, planeElements, localResultElements) ||
   726	            localResultElements > static_cast<size_t>(LLONG_MAX)) {
   727	            abortRun("local result size overflow", __FILE__, __LINE__);
   728	        }
   729	        localResult.resize(localResultElements);
   730	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(localResult.data(), input + planeElements,
     1	cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
     2

+constexpr int kBlockY = 8;
+constexpr int kHaloFromLowerTag = 1101;
+constexpr int kHaloFromUpperTag = 1102;
+constexpr int kResultTag = 1201;

+[[noreturn]] void abortRun(const char* message, const char* file, int line) {
+    int initialized = 0;
+    MPI_Initialized(&initialized);
+    int rank = 0;
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    }
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s (%s:%d)\n", rank, message, file, line);
+    std::fflush(stderr);
+    if (initialized) {
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+void checkCuda(cudaError_t status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != cudaSuccess) {
+        char message[1024];
+        std::snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "CUDA call '%s' failed: %s", expression,
+                      cudaGetErrorString(status));
+        abortRun(message, file, line);
+    }
+}
+
+void checkMpi(int status, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (status != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char error[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(status, error, &length);
+        char message[1024];
+        std::snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "MPI call '%s' failed: %.*s", expression,
+                      length, error);
+        abortRun(message, file, line);
+    }
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call) checkCuda((call), #call, __FILE__, __LINE__)
+#define MPI_CHECK(call) checkMpi((call), #call, __FILE__, __LINE__)
+
+bool checkedMultiply(size_t lhs, size_t rhs, size_t& result) {
+    if (lhs != 0 && rhs > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / lhs) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    result = lhs * rhs;
+    return true;
+}
+
+bool parseSize(const char* text, size_t& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0' || text[0] == '-') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' ||
+        parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}
+
+bool parseIterations(const char* text, int& value) {
+    if (text == nullptr || text[0] == '\0') {
+        return false;
+    }
+    errno = 0;
+    char* end = nullptr;
+    const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
+    if (errno != 0 || end == text || *end != '\0' || parsed < 0 || parsed > INT_MAX) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
+    return true;
+}
+
+void printUsage(const char* program) {
+    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", program);
+    std::printf("Options:\n");
+    std::printf("  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\n");
+    std::printf("  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\n");
+    std::printf("  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\n");
+    std::printf("  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\n");
+    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
+    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
+    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
+    std::printf("Environment:\n");
+    std::printf("  STENCIL3D_CUDA_AWARE_MPI=0|1  Override automatic CUDA-aware MPI detection\n");
+}

+struct Slab {
+    size_t globalZBegin;
+    size_t planes;
+};
+
+Slab slabForRank(size_t nz, int ranks, int rank) {
+    const size_t rankCount = static_cast<size_t>(ranks);
+    const size_t rankIndex = static_cast<size_t>(rank);
+    const size_t quotient = nz / rankCount;
+    const size_t remainder = nz % rankCount;
+    return {rankIndex * quotient + std::min(rankIndex, remainder),
+            quotient + (rankIndex < remainder ? 1U : 0U)};
 }

+__global__ void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                              Real* __restrict__ output,
+                              size_t nx, size_t ny, size_t globalNz,
+                              size_t globalZBegin, size_t localZBegin,

+    const size_t y = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y + 1;

+        }

+void launchStencilRange(const Real* input, Real* output, size_t nx, size_t ny,
+                        size_t globalNz, size_t globalZBegin, size_t localZBegin,
+                        size_t localZEnd, cudaStream_t stream) {
+    if (localZBegin > localZEnd || nx <= 2 || ny <= 2) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const dim3 block(kBlockX, kBlockY, 1);
+    const unsigned int gridX = static_cast<unsigned int>((nx - 2 + kBlockX - 1) / kBlockX);
+    const unsigned int gridY = static_cast<unsigned int>((ny - 2 + kBlockY - 1) / kBlockY);
+    constexpr size_t maxGridZ = 65535;
+
+    for (size_t first = localZBegin; first <= localZEnd;) {
+        const size_t planes = std::min(maxGridZ, localZEnd - first + 1);
+        const dim3 grid(gridX, gridY, static_cast<unsigned int>(planes));
+        stencilKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(input, output, nx, ny, globalNz,
+                                                  globalZBegin, first,
+                                                  first + planes - 1);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        first += planes;
+    }
+}
+
+bool environmentFlag(const char* value, bool& parsedValue) {
+    if (value == nullptr) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    if (std::strcmp(value, "1") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "true") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "TRUE") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "on") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "ON") == 0) {
+        parsedValue = true;
+        return true;
+    }
+    if (std::strcmp(value, "0") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "false") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "FALSE") == 0 || std::strcmp(value, "off") == 0 ||
+        std::strcmp(value, "OFF") == 0) {
+        parsedValue = false;
+        return true;
+    }
+    return false;
+}

+bool detectCudaAwareMpi(int worldRank) {
+    bool enabled = false;
+#if defined(STENCIL3D_HAS_MPI_EXT) && defined(MPIX_CUDA_AWARE_SUPPORT)
+    enabled = MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
+#endif
+
+    const char* overrideValue = std::getenv("STENCIL3D_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
+    if (overrideValue != nullptr) {
+        bool requested = false;
+        if (environmentFlag(overrideValue, requested)) {
+            enabled = requested;
+        } else if (worldRank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "Warning: ignoring invalid STENCIL3D_CUDA_AWARE_MPI='%s'\n",
+                         overrideValue);
         }
     }
+
+    int local = enabled ? 1 : 0;
+    int allEnabled = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&local, &allEnabled, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    return allEnabled != 0;
+}

+void appendReceives(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests, Real* buffer, size_t elements,
+                    int peer, int tag) {
+    if (peer == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+        return;
+    }
+    for (size_t offset = 0; offset < elements;) {
+        const int count = static_cast<int>(std::min(elements - offset,
+                                                    static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)));
+        requests.emplace_back(MPI_REQUEST_NULL);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(buffer + offset, count, MPI_DOUBLE, peer, tag,
+                            MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests.back()));
+        offset += static_cast<size_t>(count);
+    }
 }

+void postHaloExchange(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests,
+                      Real* receiveLower, Real* receiveUpper,
+                      const Real* sendLower, const Real* sendUpper,
+                      size_t planeElements, int lowerRank, int upperRank) {
+    requests.clear();

+                   kHaloFromLowerTag);
+    appendReceives(requests, receiveUpper, planeElements, upperRank,
+                   kHaloFromUpperTag);
+    appendSends(requests, sendUpper, planeElements, upperRank,
+                kHaloFromLowerTag);

+                kHaloFromUpperTag);

+void waitForRequests(std::vector<MPI_Request>& requests) {
+    if (requests.empty()) {
+        return;
+    }
+    if (requests.size() > static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)) {
+        abortRun("too many MPI requests", __FILE__, __LINE__);
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(),
+                          MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+}
